answer_1.quote: we present a new dataset DESCGEN for automatically generating entity descriptions from relevant documents and mentions

answer_2.quote: Following other summarization tasks, we evaluate the quality of generated descriptions by ROUGE ... which measures the overlap of unigram (R-1), bigram (R-2), and the longest matching sequence of words (R-L).

answer_4.quote: We present two human assessors with source documents and descriptions generated from different abstractive models and asked them to rate descriptions in terms of nonredundancy, fluency, informativeness and faithfulness.
